findings.title: Deterministic HTTP rejections retried for full retention
findings.problem: isFailingServerAnswer treats every non-JSON 4xx and every 5xx as a transient outage, so deterministic answers such as a proxy's 413 page for an oversized payload, a non-JSON 404 route error, or a 5xx the application returns every time for one poison payload are given back by settleAttempt instead of counted. The changed tests assert 413/403 HTML pages spend no attempt.
findings.impact: Such a record is never dropped after MAX_ATTEMPTS; it is re-sent on every CLI start and every Desktop daemon pass for up to CODEMIE_EVIDENCE_RECORD_IDLE_DAYS (90 d). listCandidates picks the newest 5 records (RECONCILE_PER_START) with no rotation, so five such newer records hold every start slot and starve older deliverable records.
findings.recommendation: Decide whether deterministic answers (413 Payload Too Large, 404/405 route errors, a 5xx repeated for one payload) should keep being given back for CODEMIE_EVIDENCE_RECORD_IDLE_DAYS. If not, count 413 (and other non-transient 4xx) in isFailingServerAnswer, or cap give-backs per record; if yes, make listCandidates rotate records that were given back so they cannot hold all RECONCILE_PER_START slots, and document the behaviour.
findings.check_notes: Id-mapped decision: kept as designed (give-back within retention, no per-status exception, no slot rotation) with non-empty rationale.

findings.title: End metric not delivered exactly once
findings.problem: The story requires the end metric to be delivered exactly once after the server recovers, but the endMetricSentAt once-marker is saved only after a confirmed 2xx: a process cut between the 2xx and that save re-sends it (the ticket reports a duplicate in 19 of 20 runs), and a 502/504 returned after the backend already stored the metric is now given back and re-sent on later passes. Nothing deduplicates; docs/ARCHITECTURE-PROXY.md documents at-least-once pending backend idempotency, with no backend ticket filed.
findings.impact: Story AC 'the end metric is delivered exactly once' is partial: duplicate end metrics can reach analytics, and the change widens the re-send window for 502/504-after-commit across more passes.
findings.recommendation: Get a product/backend decision on the story's exactly-once criterion: either make POST /v1/metrics idempotent (e.g. a session-scoped idempotency key on the end metric) and file the backend ticket, or record endMetricSentAt durably before/atomically with the send acknowledgement and explicitly accept at-least-once for 502/504-after-commit in the story. Until decided, the story AC stays partial.
findings.check_notes: Id-mapped decision: accepted by story owner as known limit; exactly-once only for 2xx-seen deliveries, backend idempotency out of scope; rationale given.
